headline: On People search nexus (~34, local 768-dim, no metered API) matches GPT-4o agentic ReAct (~32). Trails on Customer/Artifact/Content; Customer=0 is an entity-emission/data-join gap (CUST-id not resolved to company name), not a retrieval failure — being addressed.

company_gap_diagnosis.symptom: company recall = 0; arm emits raw CUST-ids (CUST-0018) or hallucinates 'Salesforce', not gold names (FusionTech).
company_gap_diagnosis.step1_fix_applied: Indexed customer/employee ID->name records (load_entity_records); collection 1462 -> 1559 artifacts.
company_gap_diagnosis.step1_result: Necessary but NOT sufficient — company recall still 0.
company_gap_diagnosis.root_cause: Multi-hop join. Customer records ARE indexed and retrievable (verified: 'Customer CUST-0035: ... at company FusionTech'), but the single-pass nx_answer plan retrieves on the original question (surfacing issue artifacts with CUST-ids) and never issues the dependent second query to resolve CUST-id -> company name.
company_gap_diagnosis.interpretation: Concrete confirmation of HERB's thesis: source-aware MULTI-HOP retrieval is the bottleneck, not single-hop recall. The join data is present; a multi-hop-capable plan (retrieve issues -> extract CUST-ids -> retrieve those customer records -> emit names) or HERB's more-attempts strategy is required.
company_gap_diagnosis.next_phase: Add a dependent-retrieval plan step for ID->name resolution, or a re-query loop.
